results.original_name: Looney Tunes: Bugs Bunny 80th Anniversary Collection
results.overview: Bugs Bunny first hopped onto the screen in 1940 and he’s been a pop-culture icon ever since. More than eight generations have enjoyed the timeless antics of the carrot-munching wise guy who always outsmarts his rivals. Cartoons, movies, TV, comics, music, sports and more – this wascally wabbit has done it all. Clever pranks and one-liners are here, along with interviews with today’s most renowned animators, historians and superstars. Enjoy the full range of his silly and smart-alecky personality with 60 theatrical shorts restored and remastered to their original 4x3 aspect ratio on Blu-ray for the first time. It's just what the doctor – er, doc – ordered.
results.name: Looney Tunes: Bugs Bunny 80th Anniversary Collection

results.original_name: Looney Tunes presents Bugs and Daffy's Thanksgiving Road Trip
results.overview: When Bugs and Daffy get invited to the Warner Bros backlot for a big Thanksgiving feast, Daffy refuses to go unless he gets to be the official bird of Thanksgiving. The only way to do that? Make Daffy the star of a big-budget holiday movie: Thanksgiving Day. Only problem is, Daffy isn't famous enough to star in his own movie, so Bugs and Daffy have to take a road trip all across the country, making stops at football games, chili cook-offs, and fashion shows in order to raise Daffy's profile, get his movie made, and make him the Thanksgiving Duck.
results.name: Looney Tunes presents Bugs and Daffy's Thanksgiving Road Trip
